description: Reserve a LOCAL portable CueFrame template package ZIP for import into the organization library. Supply idempotencyKey, archiveSha256 (exact lowercase SHA256) and archiveBytes (1..128MiB). Returns uploadId and a short-lived single PUT uploadUrl. PUT the exact raw archive bytes with Content-Type application/zip, then call import_template_package using uploadId. A reservation is not an import or a media item. Organization-library operation; project-bound editor credentials are refused.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.
